messages:
oliver (partner-ops): quick sync — ModelX just agreed to provide weights; they said 'permissive non-commercial' + re-distribution allowed for cloud marketplace bundles. need confirmation on exact SPDX and whether quantized redistributions are ok. also hw partner wants to bundle with their edge sku. :thinking:

jordan (legal): @oliver can you paste the exact clause? 'permissive non-commercial' is ambiguous. if it's non-commercial, marketplace resale is a blocker. we need the supplier's license file or a signed addendum that explicitly permits marketplace redistribution and commercial bundling. :warning:

oliver (partner-ops): here's excerpt from their email: "we license weights under a community-friendly grant; commercial redistribution requires a separate commercial license, but redistribution for cloud marketplace listings with revenue share is permitted if agreed." not a formal SPDX label.

kai (product): rough product implications: we can expose ModelX as a hosted model variant, and also as a dedicated SKU for customers. but if commercial redistribution needs extra signoff, we can't list them in cloud marketplaces or preinstall on hardware bundles until legal signs off. from infra side, we need to know permitted artifacts: raw fp16, int8 quantized, and a +onnx export.

sophie (eng): technical ask: does the license allow us to ship quantized weights produced by Redwood tooling? Some upstream licenses restrict derivative works — quantization might be treated as derivative. we should get explicit permission for generated quantized artifacts and packaging into a bundle.

jordan (legal): exactly. request the partner to confirm in writing: (1) permission to redistribute model weights in quantized/converted formats, (2) permission to include in cloud marketplace listings and OEM/hardware bundles, and (3) logo/brand usage terms for joint announcement. i'll draft a short addendum template.

maria (marketing): timeline angle — marketing needs 2 weeks lead for a joint announcement + co-branded assets. if legal needs addendum, that will slip announcement. can we do a private beta listing (no public marketplace page) until agreements finalized? :eyes:

liam (hw-partner): from HW side, we plan to ship the model baked into our appliance image (edge SKU). we also want to list a combined SKU on partner marketplaces. we need license clarity about pre-install vs. providing a download link that the customer pulls post-purchase. pre-install generally requires stronger commercial rights.

anne (si): SI note — our integration playbook will include reference architecture docs, a quickstart Ansible role, and a validation test suite. if the license restricts distribution, we can host model artifacts in a private customer bucket and run provisioning steps that pull them during install (not bundled). that's more friction but legal-safer.

oliver (partner-ops): next steps I propose: jordan publishes addendum draft today, I push for partner sign-off on quantization + marketplace clauses, kai/sophie list allowed artifact formats, maria proposes announcement window conditioned on signed addendum, liam/anne confirm distribution pathway (preinstall vs pull). I'll ping ModelX legal.

jordan (legal): will do. draft will include: explicit grant for derivative formats (quantized, ONNX, pruned), permission to redistribute as part of commercial marketplace bundles, and a short IP warranty and attribution clause. please expect draft by EOD.

kai (product): for the allowed artifact formats, add: fp16, bf16, int8 (per our quant tool), and ONNX v1.13 exports. also call out that we need permission to run auto-batching and caching (runtime hooking) — some model providers balk at 'modifying' runtime behavior.

sophie (eng): added: we may need to ship a small compatibility shim (license-preserving) that adjusts KV cache layout for our runtime. request explicit allowance for runtime shims and server-side performance tweaks that don't change model outputs.

maria (marketing): if legal approves a staged announcement, propose: week 1 — private customer email + partner portal note; week 2 — joint blog + tweet + marketplace listing (if allowed). need logos, legal blurb, 1-sheeter.

oliver (partner-ops): I've pinged ModelX legal. they replied: "we can sign an addendum for commercial redistribution limited to cloud and certified hardware partners; OEM preinstall needs a separate commercial agreement." so kind of expected.

liam (hw-partner): that means for our appliance we'll need a separate commercial buyout per shipment. can we do per-customer purchase flow where Redwood verifies a per-device entitlement and pulls from ModelX's licensed bucket? that avoids preinstall.

anne (si): that per-device entitlement flow is feasible. we'll need an entitlement API+audit log — engineering estimate 2 weeks to implement end-to-end (authn/authz + provisioning).

kai (product): decision point: do we proceed with marketplace listing + hosted model immediately (if addendum signed), and delay hardware preinstall until separate COM license? that seems lower friction.

jordan (legal): yes. we can negotiate addendum for marketplace + redistribution of quantized artifacts. hardware preinstall to be handled via a commercial OEM agreement. I'll cc modelX counsel and draft terms accordingly.

maria (marketing): OK — plan acceptable. I'll draft comms for a 'partner preview' that doesn't mention preinstalled appliance.

deploy-bot: Documentation ticket created: "PARTNERS-482 - ModelX license addendum + marketplace onboarding" (<https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PARTNERS-482>)

oliver (partner-ops): thanks team. action items summarized: jordan -> send addendum draft (EOD), modelX -> sign addendum for marketplace/quantization, kai/sophie -> confirm artifact list and runtime shim permissions, anne/liam -> prototype entitlement pull flow estimate, maria -> announcement copy for partner preview. will follow up in 48h. :thumbsup:
